page.content:
Twin Grand Tour probes that left the planets and entered interstellar space.

How Voyager program connects

  • Item: Voyager 1 — Voyager 1 is one of the two Voyager Grand Tour probes.
  • Topic: NASA — The Voyager program is NASA's Grand Tour and interstellar mission pair.
  • Faction: Jet Propulsion Laboratory — JPL built and still operates the Voyager probes.

What is Voyager program?

Voyager 1 and 2, managed at JPL, flew the outer planets in the 1970s–80s. Both later crossed the heliopause and still return data from interstellar space.

Key threads lead to Voyager 1, NASA and Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
